provenance.subject: RE: Northwind MSA renewal - signature needed

text:
Niko,

Following our call, Contoso agrees to renew the Northwind master services agreement for another 12 months at the revised rate ($42,000/mo), effective October 1st. This supersedes the draft you sent in June; please countersign the attached and return by Friday so we can close the quarter.

Best,
Rhea Contoso
Contoso Procurement
This Week at Northwind: five tips for a faster Q3 close, our new office plants, and a recap of last month's town hall. Unsubscribe at any time.
